source: US DOL OFLC, PERM permanent labor certification disclosure files
caveats: PERM is the permanent-residence step and is a different, much smaller program than H-1B. These counts are NOT a subset of the H-1B counts on the same industries and must not be shown as a share of them.
Industry is the employer's own NAICS code on its own filing. A firm that owns gas stations and does something else too files everything under one code.
Citizenship is published from FY2013 and country of birth from FY2015. Both were removed after FY2024, so this series has ended.
Certified filings only. A certification is permission to sponsor, not a hire.
No worker is named in the federal file and none is named here.
